cohort: The study included 106 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent prophylactic internal iliac balloon occlusion (PIIBO) over a 12-year period.
finding: Prophylactic internal iliac balloon occlusion (PIIBO) resulted in no maternal or foetal mortality, 100% uterus conservation, and 18.9% of patients experienced complications (6.6% post-operative PPH, 12.3% arterial thrombus), all successfully managed with no long-term sequelae.
